title: OpenInTerminal App Catalog
description: Declarative catalog of applications OpenInTerminal knows how to open paths with. Bundled inside the app; user-defined entries in config.json merge over it.

id.description: Stable identifier used by config.json refs. Never changes once shipped.

name.description: Display name; also used for `open -a <name>` and icon lookup.

bundleId.description: macOS bundle identifier, used for installed-app detection.

options.description: Configurable per-item options (e.g. iTerm window/tab). Keys are option ids.

argv.description: Arguments appended after `/usr/bin/open`. The literal token `{paths}` is replaced by the selected paths; without it, paths are appended per `pathMode`.

pathMode.description: append: all paths appended (editors). appendFirst: first path's directory appended (terminals). placeholder: `{paths}` tokens replaced. none: no paths appended.

script.description: Name of a .scpt in Application Scripts to run instead of the general openApp script.

apply.description: Side effect for bool options when true.
Side effect executed when this value is selected.

open.description: Open recipe override when this value is selected.

apply.description: A side effect executed when an option value is set.

value.description: bool, string, or number written via CFPreferences.
